titulo: The Matic is the first robovac to get an FCC ban waiver, not that it needs it
cuerpo: The Matic is our favorite robot vacuum and robo-mop, and it's also now the first to escape the FCC's Roomba ban. Well, sort of - because the Matic wasn't banned to begin with.
